items.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

Wrapping a page with a selection area will not work if it is not the topmost route. Likely not an issue with GoRouter just my router of choice to demonstrate the issue.

**Expected results:** <!-- what did you want to see? -->

I would expect SelectionArea to not cause any issues when wrapping my routes.

**Actual results:** <!-- what did you see? -->

If I was to load the app on the initial/lowest route, then navigate to the nested route, all would work fine.

But if I go straight to the nested route, such as you might on the web, the error occurs.

<details>
<summary>Code sample</summary>

```dart
final router = GoRouter(
  // Default to the nested location
  // Or for a more realistic use-case, navigate to the url /a/b on the web
  initialLocation: '/a/b',
  routes: [
    GoRoute(
      path: '/a',
      builder: (_, __) {
        // With selection area here, error will occur
        return const SelectionArea(child: Text('Page a'));
        // With no selection area here, error will not occur
        // return Text('Page a');
      },
      routes: [
        GoRoute(
          path: 'b',
          builder: (_, __) {
            return const SelectionArea(child: Text('Page b'));
          },
        ),
      ],
    ),
  ],
);
```

</details>

  <summary>Logs</summary>
